final: WITH department_counts AS (SELECT m.department, COUNT(mem.member_id) as member_count FROM major m JOIN member mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major GROUP BY m.department), total_members AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total FROM department_counts), shares_with_avg AS (SELECT dc.department, dc.member_count, CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / tm.total as share, AVG(CAST(dc.member_count AS FLOAT) / tm.total) OVER () as avg_share FROM department_counts dc CROSS JOIN total_members tm) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - avg_share as diff_from_avg FROM shares_with_avg WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
